summary: CheerPlanner date/time display review (MM-DD-YYYY, 12h AM/PM). Playwright-driven mobile (390x844) smoke tests on applereview@cheerplanner.app. Preview was initially down (HTTP 500) because the main-agent edit mangled imports in 7 files; T1 repaired the syntax to unblock Metro, then verified formats on 13 screens. 11/13 screens are compliant. TWO formatting regressions found: (A) /competitions/{id} TEAMS TO WATCH chip renders ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD • h:mm AM/PM' (should be MM-DD-YYYY), and (B) /inbox list summary for expense drafts shows ISO 'due 2026-10-24' (should be MM-DD-YYYY). All other targets verified: chat timestamps are 12h and day dividers use Today/Yesterday only; broadcast-history, team/calendar, team/attendance, calendar tab, competitions detail (dates + 12h times), results, premium, household, Spirit Nationals draft (12h pickers), hotel draft 'also-captured' line all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Renders ISO date — observed 'Cheer Athletics Cheetahs | 2026-10-29 • 4:00 PM • Arena A'. Must be MM-DD-YYYY, e.g. '10-29-2026 · 4:00 PM · Arena A'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/competitions/[id].tsx (teams-to-watch chip renderer).

Expense draft summary line renders ISO date — observed 'Choreography · $275 due 2026-10-24'. Must be 'due 10-24-2026'. The draft list `summary` field needs the ISO → formatDate(...) pass before display. Reference: /app/frontend/app/inbox.tsx (summary row rendering).

action_items: Fix Teams-to-watch chip in /app/frontend/app/competitions/[id].tsx so the date passes through formatDate() (currently shows YYYY-MM-DD). The time half (12h) is already correct.

Fix /app/frontend/app/inbox.tsx draft list summary — the inbox draft's `summary` string carries the raw ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' from the backend; either reformat before display with formatDate(), or have the server return the MM-DD-YYYY form. (Open-draft modal is already correct — only the collapsed summary is wrong.)
Scan every other summary/caption line that interpolates ISO date strings from backend draft/notification payloads — same risk pattern.
Re-run the full MM-DD / 12h sweep after the two fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: MAJOR: Main-agent commit introduced a repeatable syntax bug — 'import { formatXXX } from "@/src/utils/format"' was inserted BETWEEN the opening `import {` and the specifier list of the react-native import in 6 files (inbox.tsx, household.tsx, team-access.tsx, team/broadcast.tsx, team/chat.tsx, reviews/[id].tsx), plus a mis-merged JSX block in /app/frontend/app/team/results.tsx (DateField injected inside a .map() TextInput). Preview returned HTTP 500 until T1 repaired these. Suggests the format-rewrite was done by a script that mis-anchored on `import {\n` lines — audit any remaining ts/tsx files that still have the same pattern.

GOOD: /app/frontend/src/utils/format.ts helpers (formatDate, formatTime12, formatDateTime12, formatLocalDate/Time) are consistent and defensively parse ISO/legacy strings — the two bugs above are MISSED call sites, not helper defects.
formatLocalDate/formatLocalTime correctly use device-local time — good for timestamps rendered from server Date strings.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/team/results.tsx (repaired mis-merged DateField JSX inside .map() so modal compiles; preserved intended title TextInput + DateField + remaining fields map)

Login: applereview@cheerplanner.app / Review2026! (login testID is login-submit-button, NOT login-submit).
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE for the two format regressions: both ISO strings are RAW backend values interpolated into display strings without passing through formatDate/formatDateTime12. (1) competitions/[id] teams-to-watch chip concatenates `${watch.date} • ${formatTime12(watch.time)}` — the date half was not wrapped. (2) /inbox renders draft.summary directly from the API; the server composes the summary with ISO dates. ROOT CAUSE for the preview 500: a script-based rewrite that inserted new 'import … from "@/src/utils/format"' lines using the regex of `^import {$` as an anchor matched the OPENING of the react-native multi-line import block, injecting the new imports in the middle of it and leaving dangling specifier lines → Metro SyntaxError. Mitigation: T1 reordered the imports so the react-native block is intact and the new format/DateField/TimeField imports follow it; also rebuilt the broken JSX block in results.tsx.
